summary:
The change adds a saved production/staging release channel. The channel selects the control-plane origin, the session file, and the update repository, and a "Use Staging" menu item switches it and relaunches the app. F2 is fixed: the new ControlPlaneAuth temp test checks that `start` reads the token from `sessionPath`, sends it as the bearer header, and ignores the default session file. The only uncovered lines are in main.ts; I accepted their exemption in round 2 because importing main.ts starts the app. All temp tests pass, and no findings remain.

Not approved: 48 changed line(s) are uncovered.
